connector.name: Holdings
connector.registryDescription: Let your AI send invoices and take payment - card or ACH. Free.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.getholdings, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HOLDINGS_API_KEY
env.description: Your Holdings API key. Create a free one in your Holdings workspace under Settings → API keys.

env.name: HOLDINGS_API_BASE
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://workspace.getholdings.com/api/v1; only set this to override.
